facts.text: I wrote a Python FastAPI WebSocket server that defines a websocket endpoint at /ws/{handler_name}.
I used FastAPI WebSocketDisconnect handling in the websocket endpoint.
I implemented a DataMessageHandler class with subscribe, unsubscribe, and _send_to_subscribers methods.
I used Pydantic BaseModel classes named StreamBase, DataResponseContent, DataResponseMessage, TimesaleData, and ChartData.
I set StreamBase Config to use alias_generator=to_camel and allow_population_by_field_name=True.
I created TimesaleDataHandler and ChartDataHandler classes that inherit from DataMessageHandler.
I mapped handler_name values "timesale" and "chart" to timesale_handler and chart_handler.
I used a WebSocket message command value "subscribe" to call handler.subscribe(websocket).
I used a WebSocket message command value "unsubscribe" to call handler.unsubscribe(websocket).
I stop handling messages after unsubscribing by breaking out of the receive loop.
I served an HTMLResponse at the root route "/" that opens a WebSocket connection.
I configured uvicorn to run the FastAPI app on host 127.0.0.1 and port 8000.
I created a TdConfiguration and a TdAmeritradeClient in the script.
I opened a streaming client via td_client.streaming_api_client().
I set the streaming quality of service to QOSLevel.EXPRESS.
I used futures symbols ["/ES", "/NQ"].
I used equity symbols ["SPY", "QQQ", "AAPL", "TSLA"].
I added a handler for futures timesale using stream_services.add_handler with service "TIMESALE_FUTURES" and timesale_handler.data_message_handler.
I started futures timesale streaming by calling stream_services.futures_timesale(futures_symbols).
I added a handler for futures chart minute OHLCV using service "CHART_FUTURES" and chart_handler.data_message_handler.
I started futures chart minute OHLCV streaming by calling stream_services.futures_chart_minute_ohlcv(futures_symbols).
I added a handler for equity chart minute OHLCV using service "CHART_EQUITY" and chart_handler.data_message_handler.
I started equity chart minute OHLCV streaming by calling stream_services.equity_chart_minute_ohlcv(equity_symbols).
I ran both the uvicorn server task and the stream client task concurrently using asyncio.create_task and asyncio.gather.
I encountered a WebSocketDisconnect with code 1001 during websocket.receive_json().
I encountered a ValueError: list.remove(x): x not in list when calling handler.unsubscribe(websocket).
